purpose: Attribute overlapping SPQR factor generations during one-level cube Schwarz search, including a factor under construction at RSS high-water events.

measurement.rank_certificate: rigorous LocalSupport when available; bounded SPQR fallback retained

factor_metrics.owned_factor_bytes: CHOLMOD current allocations plus owned sparse design/R arrays; an estimate separate from RSS
factor_metrics.rss: process-tree sampled RSS from the experiment watchdog
factor_metrics.peak_factor_snapshot: process high-water RSS observed at resource-stage events; includes completed and in-flight factor IDs/generations

build.instrumentation: test-only factor residency, in-flight construction, and resource-stage capture

result_notes: cube-512 and cube-1024 completed; both reached a maximum of two concurrent factor states during spqr-fixed-factor.
cube-1024 sampled tree RSS was 4,118,118,400 bytes, below the fixed 4,294,967,296 byte cap.

cube-2048 was repeated once after correcting summary normalization to retain the factor inventory in its stage-entry snapshot. Both runs failed at spqr-fixed-factor over the same 4 GiB cap; no PCG telemetry exists.

At the 2048 failure, the profile workspace factor and the operator-fixed factor under construction were both present. The owned-byte estimate is a stage-entry estimate, not a peak allocation estimate.
